It’s Election Day in America. The stakes of who will control the House and Senate are high ― and so is the anxiety.

Republicans are widely expected to lose races to Democrats in Tuesday’s midterms, but it’s not clear which party will control Congress, and if the “blue wave” Democrats are seeking will turn out to be a mirage.

You can turn off the TV tonight after polls close, or you can post through your stress as these online commentators are doing. Here’s a roundup of the funniest posts that capture the emotional rollercoaster of Election Day:
